notes.title: Crypt Crawler in Zombies vs Vampires Fest!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44913221/02ea1dea786bad678bcdadeb30d57cff795ed639.png

Crypt Crawler is in the Zombies vs Vampires Fest starting today at 10 AM PT through June 2!

You can play the demo -- the first five full levels of the game as well as random dungeon generation mode -- in your quest to close the portal to the underworld before the undead take over the realm. Play with up to 4 friends in local co-op!

This updated demo has:

 Larger UI for a better experience on Steam Deck
 Enemy toughness scaling according to the number of players
 And miscellaneous optimizations bug fixes

notes.title: Update for August 4, 2024
notes.content:
Added some fixes and quality of life tweaks:

 Slowed down sprinting to a more reasonable speed.
 Elevator now shows "Everyone must be on" when waiting for everyone to get on.
 Fixed: Distance tethering now ignores dead players.
 Tuned placement of first lever in The Outer Ward.


The demo will be available until August 11, 2024. 

The next demo will be Steam Next Fest!

notes.title: Crypt Crawler Demo Update v20240801.1
notes.content:
Demo v20240801.1 is now available!

Players can now sprint for short durations.
Better targeting and indication of which structure will be deconstructed when deconstructing.
Reminder indicators over arrow towers prior to first time reloading an arrow tower.
